published.source: Paladin PR (rotation audit pass 23: Hammer of Wrath above Consecration, 2026-10-16)

summary: The Holy Shock build, keeping Judgement of the Crusader on the boss for the raid.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5s, Light's Vigil at -3s, Seal of the Crusader at -1.5s
Hammer of Wrath below 20% health, first of all
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull (the duty): 161 Holy damage taken for 40s, refreshed by the paladin's own melee hits, so one cast lasts the fight; judged again only if it drops
Seal of Righteousness back up ahead of Consecration whenever it is down (right after the opening Judgement of the Crusader)
Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness; re-seal Righteousness whenever it is down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil whenever it is not on the target and mana is at or above 30%
Holy Shock on a Vigil-marked target (detonates it, refunds 75% of its mana, starts no cooldown), or on cooldown below 30% mana; Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Runs short of mana: 4.0% ahead of twist at 120s, 2.7% at 180s, 1.0% behind at 300s.
Divine Precision's hit doesn't cover Judgement of Righteousness.
Holy Shock is worth 148 DPS and Light's Vigil about 91 (before client 70425).
A missed Holy Shock wastes the Vigil (about 1% Holy miss).
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once (70425 tooltip). Counted twice it would be 46-51 DPS higher. At the proc spell's 0 it would be 53-59 lower.
notes: Request: paladin__level_60_shock with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_shock_crusader_duty rotation.
